Use case: stylized-concept

Primary request: one DELICATE THIN luminous cyan optical-glass orbital halo, an airy perfectly circular front-facing instrument with slender broken arcs, fine radial ticks and several subtle concentric luminous filaments. The annulus must be elegant and visually light, not a heavy metal portal or thick mechanical ring. Original refined science-fiction design, beautiful cyan #5cecf7 and ice-blue optical glass and cool white glints.

Crucial: the WHOLE OUTER HALO INCLUDING ALL GLOW must fit within the central 70% of the canvas, leaving a very generous 15% absolutely transparent safety margin on every edge. No core, no center dot, no central glow, no crossing lines, no spokes. Balanced circle, the top, bottom, left and right of the full rim all completely visible and far away from the canvas edges.
Material and lighting: luminous holographic optical glass, subtle dimensional depth, delicate interrupted cyan light arcs, restrained emission that reads clearly at 280 pixels on deep navy #06111c. Very fine crisp engineered detail without clutter.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, both the large empty center and generous outer margin must be fully transparent. No baked backdrop, no floor, no rectangle, no checkerboard.
Constraints: asset artwork only, no interface, no mockup, no text, no numbers, no letters, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no extra objects, no clipped glow or rim. Do not fill the canvas with the circle: preserve the large 15% transparent margin.
